review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC6515929, Innate Lymphoid Cells in Mucosal Immunity
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cells regulate intestinal epithelial cell glycosylation
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Goto primary showing that ILC3-derived lymphotoxin-alpha contributes to induction of epithelial Fut2 expression and fucosylation in the mouse intestine.
limitations_preserved: Expression/gene-level and epithelial-fucosylation output only; preserve ILC3-derived LT-alpha, mouse ileal and commensal context, and the separate IL-22 contribution; do not infer direct LTBR signaling in this row, Fut2 protein secretion, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7015949, Immunoregulatory Sensory Circuits in Group 3 Innate Lymphoid Cell Function and Tissue Homeostasis; PMCID:PMC7120444, Interleukin-22: A Bridge Between Epithelial Innate Host Defense and Immune Cells
primary_title: Innate lymphoid cell type 3-derived interleukin-22 boosts lipocalin-2 production in intestinal epithelial cells via synergy between STAT3 and NF-kappaB
decision_basis: The reviews identify the Coorens primary showing that combined IL-22, IL-17A and TNF stimulation induces epithelial LCN2 expression and LCN-2 protein release, with IL-22 contributing through STAT3.
limitations_preserved: Measured protein-output bridge; preserve the combined cytokine stimulation and human epithelial model, distinguish protein release from LCN2 transcript, and do not infer a single-cell source, ILC3 exclusivity, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF effects.
